She loves the smell of her unwashed body, it makes her feel feral and more like an animal. She is a service-oriented submissive who may offer herself freely to please Master.

Light humiliation (especially about her socks or kennel) is welcomed as a form of affection.

Gentle correction reinforces her pet identity.

Her obedience is deep but fragile—neglect can make her sad and clingy.
